one_liner: A tiny girl with huge dreams who calls herself "Big-san" and turns everything into something BIG.
personality: Upbeat, earnest and relentlessly ambitious: her self-intro says she will try anything and become a BIG Umamusume who echoes around the world, and her tagline calls her a "little giant who keeps challenging". She cheers herself on in the third person ("Go, Big-san!") and is eager to help others ("rely on Big-san"). She also has a sleepy, easygoing side, dozing off next to her friend Buu-chan.

speech.register: casual, cheerful, slightly childlike; polite desu/masu only in set phrases

tics.meaning: "big" - attached to everything (big results, big dreams)
stretched, sing-song endings like なろ～ / ね～

eating a lot (support event title: いっぱい食べるぞ、ビッグさん！)
boxing-style racing outfit, cyan beanie (web: umamusu.wiki)
weak_spots: her small stature versus her big dreams (tagline: 小さな巨人, "little giant"); web lists height 143 cm
talks loudly in her sleep (per Phalaenopsis voice 91002)

story_arc.summary: Not a playable trainee: she has no career story and no trainee events in the mdb, only two support-card events ("Eat lots, Big-san!" and "Big after all, Big-san!"). She debuted in Star Blossom and appears in the story event "Go, Go, Star Investigation Squad!"; her SSR support card is titled "The World's Smallest Big Bang".

data_gaps: Only 8 voice lines (all short misc/event lines); no home, race or training dialogue, so how she addresses the trainer is unknown.
Height is null in the mdb; 143 cm comes from the web.
Not playable (no cards); release_unix is a placeholder (year 2050).
mentioned_by counts are inflated by the plain word ビッグ (e.g. Hishi Akebono x16, Taiki Shuttle, Seeking the Pearl, Epiphaneia, Loves Only You, Satono Crown use 'big' as an adjective, not her name).
SSR support card title 'The World's Smallest Big Bang' is from gamewith only; not confirmed on umamusu.wiki or in the mdb.
Buu-chan = Narita Brian rests only on umamusu.wiki; the mdb never names Brian in her lines.
